title: Head and neck cancer treatment outcome prediction: a comparison between machine learning with conventional radiomics features and deep learning radiomics.
summary: The retrospective study trained clinical/conventional-radiomics and image-based CNNs on 139 patients at Oslo and externally tested on 99 at Maastricht for overall and disease-free survival. Full text reports highest external performance for CNN image models and better results after combining clinical/radiomics features, while feature selection overfit. This is a bounded clinical outcome-prediction result.
